Peptides for weight loss, compared with the approved shots.

Peptide Chooser editorial team. Last updated 30 Oct 2026. Every claim links to its source. Prices checked 30 Oct 2026.

Two weekly shots are FDA approved for weight management, semaglutide (Wegovy) and tirzepatide (Zepbound), both on prescription. Online clinics also sell compounded copies, cheaper and not checked by the FDA batch by batch. Retatrutide is still in trials and sold only by research-use shops. Below: what each option costs at the clinics we track, and which clinics have an FDA warning letter.
